problems.detail: DOCX text extraction has no decompression bound (zip bomb). officeZipWithinLimits() exists for this (src/lib/knowledge-documents.ts:31, used by the preview route) but is not called, and uploads do not check it. Measured: 61 KB DOCX -> 60 MB inflated XML, +254 MB RSS. A crafted DOCX can crash the shared process on every PPK PDF build, and that build runs from employee and inspector endpoints. This breaks the 'без падения' rule of Р7 (AC5).
problems.suggestion: In docxText: if (!officeZipWithinLimits(bytes)) return null (or plan skip 'limit'); optionally also refuse when word/document.xml's uncompressed size is over a few MB before async('string').

problems.detail: AC2 requires the plaque to show 'код, дата, кто утвердил'. In compact mode (app 5, app 6, /knowledge) the approver is never shown.
problems.suggestion: Render approvedBy in compact mode too (for example a second line, or the same small text after the chip).

problems.detail: Renaming a file document on /knowledge changes its revision hash (the title is part of it, Р3), but no ppk:changed is dispatched and useRevisionStates keys do not change. The plaque stays 'approved' until a reload and the program does not ask again (Р4).
problems.suggestion: window.dispatchEvent(new Event('ppk:changed')) after a successful PATCH in mutate.

problems.detail: The 80 MB scan byte budget also covers text/plain documents and formats that print only as a line (ZIP/RAR/XLS/DOC). When earlier scans use it up, an approved text instruction gets empty bytes and prints 'Не заполнено' under its 'ППК NNN' header, with no error (silent loss in print).
problems.suggestion: Always load text/plain docs (at most 60k chars); count only PDF, image and DOCX against the budget; skip loading bytes for formats printed as a line.

problems.detail: The 'Подпись' cell dates PIN and in-cabinet marks in Europe/Moscow, while 'Отметка' uses data.timeZone. For organisations outside Moscow the two dates in one row can differ: for Asia/Novosibirsk, a mark at 2026-11-24T18:00Z shows 'Ознакомлен и согласен, 25.11.2026, 01:00' next to 'PIN-код, 24.11.2026'. The cell has the date only, without the time.
problems.suggestion: Format with data.timeZone (pass it in) and include the time, or drop the duplicate date.

problems.detail: A blank canvas is accepted as a signature: a 600x200 all-white PNG (823 bytes) gives ok=true, so 'пустая' is blocked only on the client. Dimensions up to 4000x4000 are also allowed: a 70 KB blank PNG decodes to a 64 MB bitmap in jsPDF when the PDF is built.
problems.suggestion: Inflate IDAT and require some non-background pixels; cap the size near the pad (for example 1200x400).

problems.detail: Р5: knowledge-base documents belong to those who manage the knowledge base, yet 'knowledge:' revisions are approved with requirePpkAccess (head_chef/technologist without admin.full can approve). Head_chef/technologist (management, no journals.view) also get 403 from /api/knowledge-documents in PPK app 6: an error toast, the empty state 'нет инструкций' (the old server-rendered list showed them) and create/edit/replace buttons that return 403.
problems.suggestion: Check requireKnowledgeAccess(true) for knowledge: keys on POST; for app 6 list the docs server-side or through a PPK-scoped endpoint, and hide the manage controls without admin.full.

problems.detail: The register is org-wide even for a point-scoped manager, who sees other points' revisions (procedure titles, approvers). Р1 makes the numbering org-wide, but AC9 asks for point bounds.
problems.suggestion: For point-scoped users list only keys '@<own point>', org-wide knowledge docs and their own point's procedures.

problems.detail: Two concurrent approvals of the same unchanged content (two tabs or users) both pass the same-hash check, and the P2002 retry then gives the identical content two numbers (ППК N and N+1). Numbers stay unique, as AC1 requires.
problems.suggestion: Use pg_advisory_xact_lock on the organisation inside a transaction, re-read the latest revision and the max inside it.

problems.detail: Any employee request rebuilds the whole PDF: up to 80 MB of scans read from the DB and parsed twice by pdf-lib. Unlike the inspector route there is no rate limit, so this is easy to use for resource exhaustion.
problems.suggestion: Add a per-user limiter like inspectorPdfLimiter, or cache the built PDF by content hash.

problems.detail: The GET takes at most 300 keys, so documents after the 300th get no plaque. With about 400 or more knowledge docs the encoded docKeys query passes Node's 16 KB header limit: 431, and no plaques at all.
problems.suggestion: Look up states with a POST body, or in chunks.

problems.detail: Without a saved policy record, 2.1 prints 'Не заполнено', while the 2.1 panel offers policyTemplate() and the other text items (1.8, 2.2, 2.3, 2.9) print their template. Р7 asks for the same sources as the item window.
problems.suggestion: Fall back to policyTemplate(org name) the way the text items do.

problems.detail: Р5 says 'Сотрудник видит номер редакции', but employees see no revision code on /knowledge (plaques only for canManage, and the GET needs PPK access) or on the acknowledgement page. They see it only in the printed PPK.
problems.suggestion: Show the approved code (read-only) on /knowledge and on /acknowledge/knowledge:<id> from a server-side lookup.

problems.detail: Cosmetic. Legacy 'team-signed' scans (legacyFolder of 2.2/2.4) appear in the panels but are neither printed nor part of the 2.2 hash. The first page of the 2.4 scan carries the generic header instead of 'Приказ № N от …'. The 3.7 hints still say 'в кабинете или PIN-кодом' and do not mention finger signatures.
problems.suggestion: Include the legacyFolder files after the main scan folder; call setLabel before the heading for 2.4; update sheetHint and the 3.7 lead in ru, en and uz.
